name: macro_play
description: Executes a recorded semantic macro with 5-Tier Self-Healing fallback resolution (Tier 1 UIA -> Tier 2 OCR token -> Tier 3 32x32 pHash -> Tier 4 client offset) and Tier 5 message pump synchronization barriers.

name.description: Name of the macro to play.

speed_multiplier.description: Playback speed multiplier (1.0 = native, 2.0 = 2x speed, 0.0 = fastest/zero delay).

dry_run.description: When true, simulates self-healing resolution and execution without dispatching actual physical mouse/keyboard events.

self_heal.description: Enable 5-tier dynamic self-healing anchor resolution across window reflows and DPI scaling.
